def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Assign access as a trusted application operator.")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in ["grant-staff", "revoke-staff", "set-client-role"]:
        sub = commands.add_parser(name)
        sub.add_argument("--email", required=True)
        if name != "set-client-role":
            sub.add_argument("--complex-id", required=True, type=UUID)
        if name != "revoke-staff":
            sub.add_argument(
                "--role",
                required=True,
                choices=(
                    ["player", "coach"] if name == "set-client-role" else ["employee", "admin"]
                ),
            )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    engine = make_engine(Settings())
    try:
        with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
            change_access(
                session,
                args.command,
                args.email,
                complex_id=getattr(args, "complex_id", None),
                role=getattr(args, "role", None),
            )
        print(
            "Access updated. Existing sessions will use the current permissions on their next request."
        )
    except (ValueError, EmailNotValidError) as error:
        raise SystemExit(str(error)) from None
    finally:
        engine.dispose()

def account(session: Database, user: User, token: str) -> AccountRead:
    assignments = session.scalars(
        select(StaffAssignment)
        .join(Complex)
        .where(
            StaffAssignment.user_id == user.id,
            StaffAssignment.active.is_(True),
            Complex.active.is_(True),
        )
        .order_by(Complex.name)
    ).all()
    return AccountRead(
        id=user.id,
        name=user.name,
        email=user.email,
        client_role=user.client_role,
        phone=user.phone,
        staff_assignments=[
            StaffRead(
                complex_id=item.complex_id,
                complex_name=item.complex.name,
                city=item.complex.city,

            )

def register(data: RegisterInput, request: Request, response: Response, session: Database):
    consume_attempts(session, request, str(data.email), register=True)
    user = User(
        name=data.name,
        email=str(data.email),
        password_hash=passwords.hash(data.password.get_secret_value()),
        client_role=data.client_role,
        phone=data.phone,
        created_at=utcnow(),
    )
    session.add(user)
    try:
        session.flush()
    except IntegrityError:
        session.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(409, "Unable to create an account with these details.") from None
    csrf = create_session(session, request, response, user)
    return account(session, user, csrf)

    assignment: ComplexAdmin,

    limit: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1, le=100)] = 50,
):

def create_closure(
    facility_id: UUID,
    data: ClosureInput,
    assignment: ComplexAdmin,
    identity: CsrfIdentity,
    session: Database,
):
    facility = owned_facility(session, assignment, facility_id, lock=True)
    start = local_instant(data.starts_local, facility.complex.timezone)
    end = local_instant(data.ends_local, facility.complex.timezone)
    if start >= end or end <= utcnow():
        raise HTTPException(422, "The end must follow the start and be in the future.")
    overlap = session.scalar(
        select(FacilityClosure.id)
        .where(
            FacilityClosure.facility_id == facility.id,
            FacilityClosure.active.is_(True),
            FacilityClosure.starts_at < end,
            FacilityClosure.ends_at > start,
        )
        .limit(1)
        .with_for_update()  # Use MySQL's current read, even after an earlier auth snapshot.
    )
    if overlap:
        raise HTTPException(409, "This closure overlaps another active closure.")
    booked = session.scalar(
        select(Reservation.id)
        .where(
            Reservation.facility_id == facility.id,
            Reservation.status.in_(["pending", "confirmed"]),
            Reservation.starts_at < end,
            Reservation.ends_at > start,
        )
        .limit(1)
        .with_for_update()
    )
    if booked:
        raise HTTPException(
            409, "A pending or confirmed booking overlaps this closure. Resolve it first."
        )
    bump_schedule(session, facility, data.facility_version)
    row = FacilityClosure(
        facility_id=facility.id,
        starts_at=start,
        ends_at=end,
        reason=data.reason,
        created_by=identity.user.id,
        created_at=utcnow(),
    )
    session.add(row)
    session.commit()
    return {
        "closure": closure_read(row, zone_for(facility)),
        "facility_version": data.facility_version + 1,
    }

def claim(
    session,
    complex_id,
    facility_id,
    data,
    actor_id,
    client_id,
    source,
    response,
    *,
    client_name,
    client_phone,
):
    # Every schedule writer takes this same facility lock before checking current rows.
    facility = session.scalar(
        select(Facility)
        .where(
            Facility.id == facility_id,
            Facility.complex_id == complex_id,
        )
        .with_for_update()
    )
    if facility is None or not facility.active or not facility.complex.active:
        raise HTTPException(404, "This facility is not open for reservations.")
    team = None
    if data.team_id:
        team = session.get(Team, data.team_id)
        actor = session.get(User, actor_id)
        if (
            source != "online"
            or actor.client_role != "coach"
            or team is None
            or team.coach_id != actor_id
        ):
            raise HTTPException(403, "Only the responsible coach can book for this team.")
        if team.sport_id != facility.sport_id:
            raise HTTPException(422, "Choose a facility for your team's sport.")
    start = local_instant(data.starts_local, facility.complex.timezone)
    if start.year < 1000:
        raise HTTPException(422, "Choose a future date.")
    try:
        end = start + timedelta(minutes=data.minutes)
    except OverflowError:
        raise HTTPException(422, "Choose another date.") from None
    # Claim the unique retry key inside the transaction. These placeholder prices
    # are never committed: all checks and final price calculation follow below.
    row = Reservation(
        id=uuid4(),
        reference="OM-" + secrets.token_hex(10).upper(),
        request_id=data.request_id,
        facility_id=facility.id,
        client_id=client_id,
        client_name=client_name,
        client_phone=client_phone,
        entered_by=actor_id,
        source=source,
        starts_at=start,
        ends_at=end,
        minutes=data.minutes,
        timezone=facility.complex.timezone,
        currency=facility.complex.currency,
        base_amount=Decimal("0.00"),
        total_amount=Decimal("0.00"),
        applied_percent=Decimal("0.00"),
        weekend_applied=False,
        evening_applied=False,
        quoted_version=data.facility_version,
        created_at=utcnow(),
        status="confirmed",
        approval_status="awaiting" if source == "online" else "accepted",
        version=1,
    )
    session.add(row)
    try:
        session.flush()
    except IntegrityError:
        session.rollback()
        previous = session.scalar(
            select(Reservation).where(
                Reservation.entered_by == actor_id,
                Reservation.request_id == data.request_id,
            )
        )
        if previous is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                503, "The booking could not be confirmed. Please try again."
            ) from None
        if (
            previous.facility_id,
            previous.client_id,
            previous.starts_at,
            previous.minutes,
            previous.quoted_version,
            previous.source,
            previous.client_name,
            previous.client_phone,
            previous.team_booking.team_id if previous.team_booking else None,
        ) != (
            facility_id,
            client_id,
            start,
            data.minutes,
            data.facility_version,
            source,
            client_name,
            client_phone,
            data.team_id,
        ):
            raise HTTPException(
                409, "This booking request was already used for different details."
            ) from None
        response.status_code = 200
        return booking_read(previous)
    try:
        if start <= utcnow() or int(data.starts_local[-2:]) % 30:
            raise HTTPException(422, "Choose a future time starting on the hour or half-hour.")
        if facility.version != data.facility_version:
            raise HTTPException(
                409, "The schedule changed. Refresh available times before booking."
            )
        # Locking reads avoid an older authentication snapshot on MySQL.
        hours = session.scalars(
            select(OpeningHour).where(OpeningHour.facility_id == facility.id).with_for_update()
        ).all()
        tariff = session.scalar(
            select(FacilityTariff)
            .where(
                FacilityTariff.facility_id == facility.id,
                FacilityTariff.minutes == data.minutes,
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        local = start.replace(tzinfo=UTC).astimezone(zone_for(facility))
        if tariff is None or not interval_is_open(local, data.minutes, hours):
            raise HTTPException(
                409, "This time or duration is not available within the published hours and prices."
            )
        closed = session.scalar(
            select(FacilityClosure.id)
            .where(
                FacilityClosure.facility_id == facility.id,
                FacilityClosure.active.is_(True),
                FacilityClosure.starts_at < end,
                FacilityClosure.ends_at > start,
            )
            .limit(1)
            .with_for_update()
        )
        occupied = session.scalar(
            select(Reservation.id)
            .where(
                Reservation.facility_id == facility.id,
                Reservation.id != row.id,
                Reservation.status.in_(["pending", "confirmed"]),
                Reservation.starts_at < end,
                Reservation.ends_at > start,
            )
            .limit(1)
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if closed or occupied:
            raise HTTPException(
                409, "This time is no longer available. Please choose another time."
            )
        price = calculate_price(
            tariff.amount, local, data.minutes, facility.weekend_percent, facility.evening_percent
        )
        row.base_amount = price.base_amount
        row.total_amount = price.total_amount
        row.applied_percent = price.applied_percent
        row.weekend_applied = price.weekend_applied
        row.evening_applied = price.evening_applied
        bump_schedule(session, facility, data.facility_version)
        if team:
            session.add(TeamBooking(reservation_id=row.id, team_id=team.id, team_name=team.name))
        session.commit()
    except HTTPException:
        session.rollback()
        raise
    return booking_read(row)

def reserve_online(
    complex_id: UUID,
    facility_id: UUID,
    data: BookingInput,
    identity: CsrfIdentity,
    session: Database,
    response: Response,
):
    phone = data.phone or identity.user.phone
    if not phone:
        raise HTTPException(422, "Enter your phone number to confirm this reservation.")
    if data.phone:
        identity.user.phone = data.phone
    return claim(
        session,
        complex_id,
        facility_id,
        data,
        identity.user.id,
        identity.user.id,
        "online",
        response,
        client_name=identity.user.name,
        client_phone=phone,
    )

def reserve_for_client(
    facility_id: UUID,
    data: StaffBookingInput,
    assignment: ComplexAssignment,
    identity: CsrfIdentity,
    session: Database,
    response: Response,
):
    clients = session.scalars(
        select(User).where(User.phone == data.client_phone, User.active.is_(True))
    ).all()
    matched = [client for client in clients if name_key(client.name) == name_key(data.client_name)]
    if len(matched) > 1:
        raise HTTPException(
            409,
            "More than one account matches these contact details. Ask the customer to book from their account.",
        )
    client = matched[0] if matched else None
    return claim(
        session,
        assignment.complex_id,
        facility_id,
        data,
        identity.user.id,
        client.id if client else None,
        "staff",
        response,
        client_name=client.name if client else data.client_name,
        client_phone=data.client_phone,
    )

def accept_booking(
    reservation_id: UUID,
    data: CancelInput,
    assignment: ComplexAssignment,
    identity: CsrfIdentity,
    session: Database,
):
    facility_id = session.scalar(
        select(Reservation.facility_id)
        .join(Facility)
        .where(Reservation.id == reservation_id, Facility.complex_id == assignment.complex_id)
    )
    if facility_id is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Booking not found in this complex.")
    facility = session.scalar(select(Facility).where(Facility.id == facility_id).with_for_update())
    row = session.scalar(
        select(Reservation)
        .where(Reservation.id == reservation_id)
        .with_for_update()
        .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
    )
    if row.status == "cancelled":
        raise HTTPException(409, "This request was cancelled.")
    if row.approval_status == "accepted":
        return booking_read(row)
    if row.version != data.version:
        raise HTTPException(409, "This request changed. Refresh booking history.")
    if row.starts_at <= utcnow():
        raise HTTPException(409, "This time has started. Cancel the request instead.")
    row.approval_status = "accepted"
    row.status = "confirmed"
    row.approved_by = identity.user.id
    row.approved_at = utcnow()
    row.version += 1
    bump_schedule(session, facility, facility.version)
    notify_client(session, row, "accepted")
    session.commit()
    return booking_read(row)

def update_facility(
    facility_id: UUID,
    data: FacilityUpdate,
    assignment: ComplexAdmin,
    identity: CsrfIdentity,
    session: Database,
):
    facility = owned_facility(session, assignment, facility_id, lock=True)
    if facility.version != data.version:
        raise HTTPException(409, "This facility changed since you opened it. Reload before saving.")
    validate_sport(session, data)
    try:
        protect_confirmed_bookings(session, facility, data, utcnow())
        session.execute(delete(FacilityTariff).where(FacilityTariff.facility_id == facility.id))
        session.execute(delete(OpeningHour).where(OpeningHour.facility_id == facility.id))
        values = data.model_dump(exclude={"opening_hours", "tariffs", "version"})
        result = session.execute(
            update(Facility)
            .where(Facility.id == facility.id, Facility.version == data.version)
            .values(**values, version=data.version + 1)
            .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
        )
        if result.rowcount != 1:
            session.rollback()
            raise HTTPException(409, "This facility changed. Reload before saving.")
        save_children(session, facility, data)
        commit_settings(session)
    except IntegrityError:
        session.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(
            409, "The facility name is already used, or a setting changed. Reload and try again."
        ) from None
    session.expire_all()
    return configuration(session.get(Facility, facility_id), assignment)

def calculate_price(
    base: Decimal, start: datetime, duration: int, weekend: Decimal, evening: Decimal
) -> PriceBreakdown:
    if start.tzinfo is None or start.utcoffset() is None or start.second or start.microsecond:
        raise ValueError("An aware start time on a minute boundary is required")
    if (
        not 1 <= duration <= 1440
        or not Decimal("0") <= weekend <= Decimal("100")
        or not Decimal("0") <= evening <= Decimal("100")
    ):
        raise ValueError("Invalid pricing inputs")
    utc = start.astimezone(UTC)
    # Intervals are [start, end): touching 18:00 at the end or starting at
    # 21:00 does not overlap peak time. Walk actual minutes across clock changes.
    instants = [
        (utc + timedelta(minutes=index)).astimezone(start.tzinfo) for index in range(duration)
    ]
    on_weekend = any(instant.weekday() in {5, 6} for instant in instants)
    in_evening = any(
        18 * 60 <= instant.hour * 60 + instant.minute < 21 * 60 for instant in instants
    )
    percent = (weekend if on_weekend else Decimal("0")) + (evening if in_evening else Decimal("0"))
    total = (base * (Decimal("1") + percent / Decimal("100"))).quantize(
        CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP
    )
    return PriceBreakdown(
        base_amount=base.quantize(CENT),
        weekend_percent=weekend,
        evening_percent=evening,
        weekend_applied=on_weekend and weekend > 0,
        evening_applied=in_evening and evening > 0,
        applied_percent=percent,
        surcharge_amount=total - base,
        total_amount=total,
    )

def consume_attempts(session: Session, request: Request, email: str, *, register=False):
    """Atomic fixed-window counters shared by application processes through MySQL."""
    settings = request.app.state.settings
    now = utcnow()
    window = int(now.replace(tzinfo=UTC).timestamp()) // 600
    expiry = datetime.fromtimestamp((window + 1) * 600, UTC).replace(tzinfo=None)
    ip = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
    limits = (
        [(f"register:ip:{ip}", 20)]
        if register
        else [
            (f"login:ip:{ip}", settings.login_ip_limit),
            (f"login:email:{email}", settings.login_email_limit),
        ]
    )
    session.execute(delete(AuthAttemptBucket).where(AuthAttemptBucket.expires_at < now))
    exceeded = False
    for scope, maximum in limits:
        key = token_hash(f"{window}:{scope}")
        values = {"key": key, "attempts": 1, "expires_at": expiry}
        if session.get_bind().dialect.name == "mysql":
            statement = mysql_insert(AuthAttemptBucket).values(**values)
            statement = statement.on_duplicate_key_update(attempts=AuthAttemptBucket.attempts + 1)
        else:
            statement = sqlite_insert(AuthAttemptBucket).values(**values)
            statement = statement.on_conflict_do_update(
                index_elements=[AuthAttemptBucket.key],
                set_={"attempts": AuthAttemptBucket.attempts + 1},
            )
        session.execute(statement)
        count = session.scalar(
            select(AuthAttemptBucket.attempts).where(AuthAttemptBucket.key == key)
        )
        exceeded |= count > maximum
    session.commit()
    if exceeded:
        raise HTTPException(
            429,
            "Too many attempts. Please try again later.",
            headers={"Retry-After": str(max(1, int((expiry - now).total_seconds())))},
        )

def create_session(session: Session, request: Request, response: Response, user: User) -> str:
    settings = request.app.state.settings
    now = utcnow()
    old_token = request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie, "")
    if old_token:
        session.execute(
            delete(LoginSession).where(LoginSession.token_hash == token_hash(old_token))
        )
    session.execute(delete(LoginSession).where(LoginSession.expires_at <= now))
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    session.add(
        LoginSession(
            token_hash=token_hash(token),
            user_id=user.id,
            created_at=now,
            last_seen_at=now,
            expires_at=now + timedelta(hours=settings.session_hours),
        )
    )
    session.commit()
    response.set_cookie(
        settings.session_cookie,
        token,
        max_age=settings.session_hours * 3600,
        httponly=True,
        secure=settings.cookie_secure,
        samesite="lax",
        path="/",
    )
    return csrf_token(token)

def daily_timetable(session, facility, day, now, *, staff=False):
    zone = zone_for(facility)
    begin, end = day_bounds(day, zone)
    begin_naive, end_naive = begin.replace(tzinfo=None), end.replace(tzinfo=None)
    bookings = session.scalars(
        select(Reservation)
        .where(
            Reservation.facility_id == facility.id,
            Reservation.status.in_(["pending", "confirmed"]),
            Reservation.starts_at < end_naive,
            Reservation.ends_at > begin_naive,
        )
        .order_by(Reservation.starts_at)
    ).all()
    closures = session.scalars(
        select(FacilityClosure).where(
            FacilityClosure.facility_id == facility.id,
            FacilityClosure.active.is_(True),
            FacilityClosure.starts_at < end_naive,
            FacilityClosure.ends_at > begin_naive,
        )
    ).all()
    hours = [
        (row.start_minute, row.end_minute)
        for row in facility.opening_hours
        if row.weekday == day.weekday()
    ]
    points = []
    instant = begin
    while instant < end:
        naive = instant.replace(tzinfo=None)
        local = instant.astimezone(zone)
        minute = local.hour * 60 + local.minute
        opened = any(start <= minute < finish for start, finish in hours)
        booking = next((row for row in bookings if row.starts_at <= naive < row.ends_at), None)
        closure = next((row for row in closures if row.starts_at <= naive < row.ends_at), None)
        state = (
            "reserved"
            if booking
            else "blocked"
            if closure and opened
            else "past"
            if opened and naive <= now
            else "available"
            if opened
            else "closed"
        )
        key = (state, booking.id if booking else closure.id if closure and opened else None)
        points.append((instant, key, booking, opened or booking is not None))
        instant += timedelta(minutes=1)
    relevant = [index for index, point in enumerate(points) if point[3]]
    if not relevant:
        return []
    rows = []
    for instant, key, booking, _ in points[min(relevant) : max(relevant) + 1]:
        if rows and rows[-1]["key"] == key:
            rows[-1]["end"] = instant + timedelta(minutes=1)
            continue
        rows.append(
            {
                "key": key,
                "start": instant,
                "end": instant + timedelta(minutes=1),
                "booking": booking,
            }
        )
    result = []
    for row in rows:
        booking = row["booking"]
        item = {
            "state": row["key"][0],
            "starts_at": row["start"].astimezone(zone),
            "ends_at": row["end"].astimezone(zone),
        }
        if staff and booking:
            item.update(
                reservation_id=booking.id,
                booking_status=history_status(booking),
                client_name=booking.client_name,
                client_phone=booking.client_phone,
                minutes=booking.minutes,
                reservation_starts_at=booking.starts_at.replace(tzinfo=UTC).astimezone(zone),
                reservation_ends_at=booking.ends_at.replace(tzinfo=UTC).astimezone(zone),
                reference=booking.reference,
                walk_in=booking.client_id is None,
            )
        result.append(item)
    return result

def test_simultaneous_mysql_closures_have_one_winner_and_do_not_overlap(
    second_version, wait_for_first
):
    url = os.environ.get("OMNI_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
    if not url:
        if os.environ.get("CI") == "true":
            pytest.fail("MySQL closure concurrency proof is required in CI")
        pytest.skip("Run the Docker test service for independent-connection closure proof")
    parsed = make_url(url)
    assert parsed.get_backend_name() == "mysql" and (parsed.database or "").endswith("_test")
    settings = Settings(database_url=url, auth_origins=["http://testserver"], _env_file=None)
    engine = make_engine(settings)
    config = Config(str(ROOT / "alembic.ini"))
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        config.attributes["connection"] = connection
        command.upgrade(config, "head")
    user_id, complex_id, sport_id, facility_id = [uuid4() for _ in range(4)]
    tokens = [secrets.token_urlsafe(32), secrets.token_urlsafe(32)]
    now = utcnow()
    day = (now + timedelta(days=14)).date().isoformat()
    try:
        with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
            session.add_all(
                [
                    Complex(
                        id=complex_id,
                        name="Closure race complex",
                        city="Test",
                        address="Test",
                        timezone="UTC",
                        description="Disposable concurrency test",
                        is_demo=True,
                    ),
                    Sport(id=sport_id, slug=f"race-{sport_id.hex}", name="Closure race sport"),
                    User(
                        id=user_id,
                        name="Closure race admin",
                        email=f"{user_id.hex}@example.com",
                        password_hash=passwords.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(24)),
                        created_at=now,
                    ),
                ]
            )
            session.flush()
            session.add_all(
                [
                    Facility(
                        id=facility_id,
                        complex_id=complex_id,
                        sport_id=sport_id,
                        name="Race court",
                        surface="Hard",
                        description="Isolated",
                    ),
                    StaffAssignment(user_id=user_id, complex_id=complex_id, role="admin"),
                    *[
                        LoginSession(
                            token_hash=token_hash(token),
                            user_id=user_id,
                            created_at=now,
                            last_seen_at=now,
                            expires_at=now + timedelta(hours=1),
                        )
                        for token in tokens
                    ],
                ]
            )
        barrier = Barrier(2)
        first_done = Event()

        def synchronized_assignment(
            complex_id: UUID, identity: CurrentIdentity, session: Database, request: Request
        ):
            assignment = complex_assignment(complex_id, identity, session)
            # Both MySQL read snapshots exist before the first closure commits.
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
            if wait_for_first and request.headers.get("X-Test-Writer") == "1":
                assert first_done.wait(timeout=10)
            return assignment

        with ExitStack() as stack:
            clients = []
            for _ in tokens:
                app = create_app(settings, engine=engine)
                app.dependency_overrides[complex_assignment] = synchronized_assignment
                clients.append(stack.enter_context(TestClient(app)))
            path = f"/api/v1/staff/complexes/{complex_id}/facilities/{facility_id}/closures"

            def create(index):
                client = clients[index]
                client.cookies.set("omni_session", tokens[index])
                response = client.post(
                    path,
                    headers={
                        "X-Omni-Request": "1",
                        "Origin": "http://testserver",
                        "X-CSRF-Token": csrf_token(tokens[index]),
                        "X-Test-Writer": str(index),
                    },
                    json={
                        "facility_version": 1 if index == 0 else second_version,
                        "starts_local": f"{day}T10:00",
                        "ends_local": f"{day}T12:00",
                        "reason": f"Writer {index}",
                    },
                )
                if index == 0:
                    first_done.set()
                return response

            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
                responses = list(pool.map(create, range(2)))
            assert sorted(response.status_code for response in responses) == [201, 409], [
                response.text for response in responses
            ]
            winner = next(
                index for index, response in enumerate(responses) if response.status_code == 201
            )
            if wait_for_first:
                assert winner == 0
        with Session(engine) as session:
            rows = session.scalars(
                select(FacilityClosure).where(FacilityClosure.facility_id == facility_id)
            ).all()
            assert len(rows) == 1 and rows[0].reason == f"Writer {winner}" and rows[0].active
            assert session.get(Facility, facility_id).version == 2
    finally:
        with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
            session.execute(
                delete(FacilityClosure).where(FacilityClosure.facility_id == facility_id)
            )
            session.execute(delete(Facility).where(Facility.id == facility_id))
            session.execute(delete(StaffAssignment).where(StaffAssignment.user_id == user_id))
            session.execute(delete(LoginSession).where(LoginSession.user_id == user_id))
            session.execute(delete(User).where(User.id == user_id))
            session.execute(delete(Sport).where(Sport.id == sport_id))
            session.execute(delete(Complex).where(Complex.id == complex_id))
        engine.dispose()

                            last_seen_at=now,
                            expires_at=now + timedelta(hours=1),
                        )
                        for token in tokens
                    ],
                ]
            )
        barrier = Barrier(2)
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            clients = [
                stack.enter_context(TestClient(create_app(settings, engine=engine))) for _ in tokens
            ]
            bodies = [
                {
                    "version": 1,
                    "name": name,
                    "sport_id": str(sport_id),
                    "surface": "Hard court",
                    "active": True,
                    "description": "Concurrent test",
                    "opening_hours": [{"weekday": 0, "opens_at": opens, "closes_at": closes}],

                for name, opens, closes, amount in [
                    ("First editor", "09:00", "12:00", "100.00"),

                ]

            def edit(index):
                client = clients[index]

                barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                return client.put(
                    f"/api/v1/staff/complexes/{complex_id}/facilities/{facility_id}",

            )

                .json()
            )
            assert saved["version"] == 2

            assert saved["tariffs"] == bodies[winner]["tariffs"]

def test_concurrent_team_acceptance_has_one_winner(mode):
    url = os.environ.get("OMNI_TEST_DATABASE_URL")
    if not url:
        if os.environ.get("CI") == "true":
            pytest.fail("CI requires MySQL transfer concurrency proof")
        pytest.skip("Run Docker tests for MySQL concurrency proof")
    parsed = make_url(url)
    assert parsed.get_backend_name() == "mysql" and parsed.database.endswith("_test")
    engine = make_engine(Settings(database_url=url, _env_file=None))
    config = Config(str(ROOT / "alembic.ini"))
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        config.attributes["connection"] = connection
        command.upgrade(config, "head")
    sport_id, player_id = uuid4(), uuid4()
    coaches, teams, requests = [uuid4(), uuid4()], [uuid4(), uuid4()], [uuid4(), uuid4()]
    try:
        with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
            session.add(Sport(id=sport_id, slug=str(sport_id), name="Concurrent sport"))
            for uid, role in [(player_id, "player"), *[(uid, "coach") for uid in coaches]]:
                session.add(
                    User(
                        id=uid,
                        email=f"{uid}@example.com",
                        name="Concurrent test",
                        password_hash="unused",
                        client_role=role,
                        created_at=utcnow(),
                    )
                )
            session.flush()
            for index in range(2):
                session.add(
                    Team(
                        id=teams[index],
                        coach_id=coaches[index],
                        sport_id=sport_id,
                        name=f"Concurrent {index}",
                        created_at=utcnow(),
                    )
                )
            session.flush()
            for index in range(2):
                session.add(
                    TeamRequest(
                        id=requests[index],
                        team_id=teams[index],
                        player_id=player_id,
                        kind="join",
                        created_at=utcnow(),
                    )
                )
        barrier = Barrier(2)

        def accept(index):
            with Session(engine) as session:
                # Establish two old snapshots before either transition starts.
                session.get(TeamRequest, requests[index])
                barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                try:
                    identity = SimpleNamespace(
                        user=SimpleNamespace(id=coaches[index], client_role="coach")
                    )
                    if mode == "contact":
                        add_player(
                            teams[index],
                            AddPlayerInput(name=str(player_id), phone="0611223344"),
                            identity,
                            session,
                        )
                    else:
                        decide_request(
                            requests[index], DecisionInput(action="accept"), identity, session
                        )
                    return 200
                except HTTPException as error:
                    session.rollback()
                    return error.status_code

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            results = list(pool.map(accept, range(2)))
        assert sorted(results) == [200, 409]
        with Session(engine) as session:
            members = session.scalars(
                select(TeamMembership).where(TeamMembership.player_id == player_id)
            ).all()
            if mode == "contact":
                members = session.scalars(
                    select(TeamContactMember).where(TeamContactMember.sport_id == sport_id)
                ).all()
            assert len(members) == 1 and members[0].active_slot == 1
    finally:
        with Session(engine) as session, session.begin():
            session.execute(delete(TeamRequest).where(TeamRequest.id.in_(requests)))
            session.execute(delete(TeamMembership).where(TeamMembership.player_id == player_id))
            session.execute(delete(TeamContactMember).where(TeamContactMember.sport_id == sport_id))
            session.execute(
                delete(RosterIdentityLock).where(
                    RosterIdentityLock.key == roster_key(str(player_id), "+212611223344")
                )
            )
            session.execute(delete(Team).where(Team.id.in_(teams)))
            session.execute(delete(User).where(User.id.in_([player_id, *coaches])))
            session.execute(delete(Sport).where(Sport.id == sport_id))
        engine.dispose()
